transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

Hello, Doctor. Thank you so much for taking the time to see me. I, um, I hope I'm in the right place for this. 

I guess I'm mostly here because of some ongoing stress at my job. I'm a computer support specialist, and... well, for over a year now, I’ve just been trying to get someone to take my concerns seriously. It's about the new ticket rotation system and these recent security audits. I really believe they’re being used to build a paper trail against me. 

I mean, management keeps showing me the system logs and they keep telling me it’s just standard policy, but... I just know what I'm seeing. I'm sorry, I hope I don't sound unreasonable saying all that. I just want to figure out how to handle it. Am I explaining that clearly enough for you?
Aside from what you are noticing at work, have you ever heard voices or sounds that other people couldn't hear?

No, no, nothing like that. I mean, I know that's a common question doctors have to ask, and I completely understand why you're asking it. But no, I don't hear voices or anything that isn't really there. My hearing is perfectly normal. 

I'm just a regular guy dealing with a very specific situation at the office. I wouldn't want you to think I'm... well, you know, losing touch with reality or anything. I'm just trying to make sense of the actual things happening around me. Does that make sense? I hope I'm giving you the right kind of information.
Have you noticed similar concerns or feelings of people working against you in your personal life, such as with friends or family?

No, oh no, definitely not. My personal life is... it's very normal, very stable. I really hope I didn't give the impression that I'm suspicious of everyone, because that's not it at all. 

My wife and I are doing fine, and my friends... well, everything is completely fine there. Outside of this one specific issue with the ticket rotation and the audits at work, everything else is running smoothly. I still keep the house in order, I pay all our bills on time, I help my wife out around the house... I'm still functioning perfectly well. Even at work, I handle all the technical parts of my job just fine. No one has ever said my work is sloppy or disorganized, you know? 

I just want to be clear that this is a very isolated thing at the office. I'm still a very capable, responsible person in every other area of my life. Is that helpful to know? I just want to make sure you have the whole picture.
